messages.labels.hint: Download the PNG and insert the image in Print Master using the same label size. Print without cropping. The QR code opens consumption for this spool.
messages.labels.overrides: Known Bambu materials get guide suggestions. Saved temperatures and your edits take precedence. Choose a plate and drying method, or adjust the fields. Label changes are not saved to the spool. Unknown values appear as —.
messages.labels.invalid_options: Choose a valid label layout and size.
messages.labels.qr_too_dense: The QR link is too long for this label. Choose a larger label or the compact layout.
messages.labels.small_qr: The QR code is small at this size. Test a printed label and scanning; choose a larger label for a more robust code.
messages.labels.download_error: The label could not be downloaded. Try SVG or another browser.
messages.labels.loading_profile: Loading material values from the Bambu guide…
messages.labels.no_profile: No exact profile in the Bambu guide. Enter values manually.
messages.labels.profile_error: Material lookup could not be loaded. You can still enter values manually.
messages.labels.profile_found: Bambu guide: {material}. Saved spool values and your edits take precedence.
messages.labels.flow_not_in_guide: The guide does not specify flow ratio. Enter your own calibrated value.
messages.labels.heatbed_drying_note: When drying on the heatbed, cover the filament and turn it halfway through.
messages.labels.high_temp_drying_note: Within the guide range, a higher temperature improves drying.
messages.labels.less_effective_drying_note: The guide states that the heatbed is less effective than a blast drying oven.
messages.labels.gallery_help: Generate previews using filament guide values. Edit nozzle, bed, flow ratio and drying on each label before printing or downloading. Changes are kept only in this overview. Unknown flow ratio appears as —. Bed and drying use Textured PEI and the guide’s first drying method; other choices are available in the spool label dialog.
messages.labels.a4_help: Select spools and print classic QR labels with up to nine labels per A4 page. Use the label images above for individual labels with temperatures and drying.
messages.m220.title: Direct M220 printing · experimental
messages.m220.help: Print label images directly over Bluetooth from this device. Requires HTTPS or localhost and a browser with Web Bluetooth, such as Chrome. Safari and Firefox are unsupported. Choose the label size that matches the paper in the printer. Select only your M220; some units appear as Q… or Phomemo in the Bluetooth list.
messages.m220.ready: Connect an M220, then use Print via Bluetooth on an individual label. Existing Print and Download buttons remain available.
messages.m220.secure_required: Bluetooth requires HTTPS or localhost. Open the app’s HTTPS address on this device.
messages.m220.unsupported: This browser has no Web Bluetooth support. Use a supported Chrome/Chromium browser on a Bluetooth-capable computer or Android device. Existing Print and Download still work.
messages.m220.connecting: Select the M220 in the Bluetooth picker. Connecting…
messages.m220.connected: Connected to {name}. Ready to send one label at a time.
messages.m220.cancelled: No printer selected. You can connect again.
messages.m220.permission_denied: Bluetooth access was blocked. Allow Bluetooth for this site in the browser and try connecting again.
messages.m220.wrong_device: Select an M220 printer. Other models are not supported by this extension.
messages.m220.incompatible: The selected printer has no compatible Bluetooth write characteristic.
messages.m220.connection_failed: Could not connect to the M220. Turn it on, bring it closer and disconnect it from Print Master or other apps before trying again.
messages.m220.disconnected: M220 disconnected. Connect again to print via Bluetooth.
messages.m220.busy: A Bluetooth operation is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
messages.m220.invalid_image: No valid thermal label is available. Generate an M220 label before printing.
messages.m220.invalid_settings: Choose density 1–8, paper feed 0–255 dots, and normal or slow transfer.
messages.m220.sending: Sending label to M220: {percent}%. Keep this page open.
messages.m220.sent: Label sent to M220. Physical printing is not confirmed; check the label and scan its QR code.
messages.m220.send_failed: Bluetooth printing stopped. The label may have printed partly or fully. Check the printer before reconnecting and sending it again; nothing is retried automatically.
